name: What Is Love?
summary: Gakin the Darkbinder seeks a wooden figurine whose age and history make it fit for an incubus ritual. Its devotion may draw the creature close.

sections.title: An Old Keepsake
sections.body: Gakin the Darkbinder has located a figurine with his scrying. He says it once belonged to a young couple thousands of years ago, and its owners are gone. You are asked to bring the keepsake from a house beyond Maestra's Post in Ashenvale to Gakin in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

sections.title: The Figurine's Power
sections.body: When you return the wooden figurine, Gakin senses its emotional force remains strong despite the passage of time. He says the incubus will be drawn to it, making it the reagent he needs for the ritual.

faq.q: What does Gakin want me to find?
faq.answer: Gakin asks you to retrieve a wooden figurine that he believes will draw an incubus to his ritual.
Gakin says it is in a house beyond Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
The figurine belonged to a young couple thousands of years ago.

faq.q: Why does Gakin want the figurine?
faq.answer: Gakin senses emotional energy in the figurine and says it will attract an incubus for his ritual.

attribution: In-game quest text: What Is Love?
